name: Stratified Monte Carlo Radiance Estimate
definition: An unbiased radiance estimate $\hat{C}(\mathbf{r})$ that uses stratified sampling to reduce variance compared to uniform sampling, particularly effective for degenerate distributions.
summary: Stratified Monte Carlo Radiance Estimate is an unbiased method that reduces variance by dividing the ray interval into bins and sampling one point per bin, ensuring better coverage than uniform sampling.
